hero.title: Mortgage pre-approval with Broker Lenders
hero.lead: Know your real budget before you tour a single home. Start with a free pre-qualification that takes minutes and does not touch your credit, then get a pre-approval letter sellers take seriously.

compare.title: Pre-qualification vs. pre-approval
compare.prequalText: A quick estimate built from what you tell us about your income and debts. Useful to set your price range. Free, and no impact on your credit.
compare.preapprovalText: We review your credit, income and assets and issue a letter with an amount and conditions. This is the letter that makes your offer competitive.
compare.guide: Read the full guide: why one gets your offer accepted and the other does not

steps.title: How it works
steps.s1Text: A short form with your income and debts. In minutes you know your range, with no credit impact.
steps.s2Text: Pedro Lira reviews your credit, pay stubs and bank statements to confirm what you can finance.
steps.s3Text: Amount, loan type and expiration, signed with his NMLS number, ready to submit with your offer.

docs.title: What to have ready
docs.d2: Pay stubs from the last 30 days.
docs.d3: W-2s or tax returns from the last two years.
docs.d4: Two months of complete bank statements.
docs.d5: Self-employed: two years of returns and business statements.
docs.d6: Veterans: your DD214 and, ideally, your Certificate of Eligibility.

letter.title: What a solid letter shows
letter.l1: Maximum loan amount and the purchase price it supports.
letter.l2: Loan program (conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, jumbo) and planned down payment.
letter.l4: What was verified and what is still pending.
letter.l5: The loan officer's name and NMLS number.

risks.title: What can undo it
risks.r1: Financing a car or opening new credit.
risks.r4: A late payment during the process.
risks.r5: An appraisal that comes in below the price.

faq.title: Pre-approval FAQs
faq.q1: What is the difference between pre-qualification and pre-approval?
faq.a1: Pre-qualification is a quick estimate based on what you tell us. Pre-approval reviews your credit, pay stubs and bank statements, and ends in a letter with an amount and conditions you can submit with an offer.
faq.a2: Pre-qualification does not. Pre-approval usually involves a credit inquiry that can cost a few points, but several mortgage inquiries within a short window count as one.
faq.q3: How long is a pre-approval letter good for?
faq.a3: Usually 60 to 90 days, because documents and the credit report expire. It can be renewed with updated pay stubs and bank statements.
faq.a4: No. No letter is a guarantee. Final approval depends on full underwriting, the appraisal and your finances not changing before closing.
